title: Anxiolytic Effects of Socio-aesthetics in Cancer Patients Undergoing Chemotherapy
official: Anxiolytic Effects of Socio-aesthetics in Cancer Patients Undergoing Chemotherapy (PASITHEA)
summary: The purpose of the study is to assess the average of the "State Anxiety" score of the State Trait Inventory Anxiety at the end of the third cycle of chemotherapy compared to the pre-treatment score (inclusion)
sponsor: GCS Ramsay Santé pour l'Enseignement et la Recherche
